question: In May 2021, ushering in his second term, Pinarayi Vijayan took the oath as the _____________ Chief Minister of Kerala.
solution:
The correct answer is **__13th__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In May 2021**, ushering in his second term, **Pinarayi Vijayan** took the oath as the 13th **Chief Minister of Kerala.**
 
• He served as the secretary of the Kerala State Committee of the CPI(M) from 1998 to 2015.
 
• Chief Minister of Kerala beginning at** 25 May 2016. **
 
• Member of the CPI(M) politburo **beginning at 2002.**
 
• He was directed the oath by **Governor Arif Mohammad Khan **about Central Stadium in **Thiruvananthapuram.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
